entries.base_behavior: Audit/Replay v3 section 8 orders the box before the target; A2-01 resolved the same conflict for SSOT only.
entries.amended_behavior: A2-01 target-first precedence also governs Audit/Replay v3: wherever it orders the box before the target, SSOT section 17.1 controls. RouteEvaluation is not moved.
entries.reason: Without it the replay workflow could later be read as contrary authority.

entries.base_behavior: Audit/Replay v3 line 55 gives M1 no box role while its section 13.1 names M1 box evidence; section 17.4 names no freeze timeframe.
entries.amended_behavior: M1/tick may contribute PressureRange evidence, ExecutionBox evidence, entry timing, fill/path observation and MAE/MFE, but must not independently create or freeze a canonical box or determine route policy. Freeze authority is an approved route policy plus the closed-candle authority it names.
entries.reason: Evidence is not authority; two lines of one document must not keep yielding different readings.

entries.base_behavior: The route registry carries only route, direction, location alignment and quote requirement; no route has an executable interval or freeze rule.
entries.amended_behavior: A route policy is canonical only if route, policy identity, eligible proof forms, closed-candle authority, source evidence requirements, BUILDING predicate, box_low and box_high derivations, FROZEN predicate, freeze reason, invalidation basis and future-evidence prohibition are all defined; otherwise NOT_CANONICALLY_IMPLEMENTABLE and no canonical box. No fallback to M1, ExecutionBoxV1, the v2 first-M15 rule or a generic interval.
entries.reason: Route geometry is strategy behavior and cannot be chosen by an implementer.

entries.base_behavior: Six routes are named in prose; route labels in code are free strings.
entries.amended_behavior: Closed six-route vocabulary with independent spec, evidence and runtime status axes. BREAK_RETEST and BREAKOUT_ACCEPTANCE are SPEC_DEFINED (proposed); the other four are NOT_YET_DEFINED; all are EVIDENCE_PENDING and RUNTIME_DISABLED. FAILED_RECLAIM is a completion kind, not a route. A3 approval turns no route on.
entries.reason: Enable only routes the proof machinery actually supports.

entries.base_behavior: Proof levels and closed-candle prices are float; no clause fixes the box bound representation.
entries.amended_behavior: Canonical box bounds use the existing Price type (Decimal, 12 dp). Legacy float evidence is canonicalized once by Decimal(str(value)); a value not fitting Price is rejected, never rounded. Hashing uses fixed-point decimal strings without exponent or trailing zeros. Float arithmetic into material_box_hash, float equality for versioning and broker tick_size quantization are forbidden.
entries.reason: Float artifacts must never decide a box version.

entries.base_behavior: A1-12 says MATERIAL_RANGE_CHANGE affects the box once 12C exists; section 16.3 closed cause list omits PressureRange.
entries.amended_behavior: A PressureRange change requires box re-evaluation but alone never forces a box_version increment; a version is appended only if the approved box material projection changes. pressure_range_id is lineage, not material.
entries.reason: Upstream truth changing does not mean downstream material changed.

entries.base_behavior: Section 16.3 names target/invalidation revision as a box change cause; A2-07 defines no box reaction.
entries.amended_behavior: requires_box_reevaluation is false for TARGET_UNCHANGED and true for TARGET_MATERIAL_CHANGE, TARGET_NO_LONGER_ELIGIBLE and TARGET_INVALIDATED. resulting_box_state is never mapped from a target fact; it follows only from re-derivation, the material projection and the SUPERSEDED/INVALIDATED rule.
entries.reason: A target fact is an obligation to re-derive, not a state.

entries.base_behavior: Section 4.1 names execution_box_id + box_version; nothing fixes the tuple.
entries.amended_behavior: execution_box_id = UUIDv5 over [box derivation version, strategy_thesis_id, route, box_policy_id, box_policy_version]; revision = (execution_box_id, box_version). pressure_range_id, target_id, proof revision, source evidence, admission class and clocks stay outside the id. Route or policy change creates a new id. Version 1 is created with the record; versions are contiguous, append-only and linked to the previous version and its material hash.
entries.reason: Separate logical identity from material revisions.

entries.base_behavior: Section 16.3 lists what may and may not change a box; no field partition exists.
entries.amended_behavior: GEOMETRY_MATERIAL = box_low, box_high; AUTHORITY_MATERIAL = structural_proof_id, context_epoch_id; LINEAGE (not hashed) = pressure_range_id, target_id, target fact, source candle ids, observed_through_utc, containment sidecar; NON_MATERIAL = telemetry, deployment, request, publisher, broker quote, reference price, observational timestamps, box_version. material_box_hash covers GEOMETRY and AUTHORITY material only; box_version increments iff it changes under the same id. target_id is lineage because the proposed policies do not read the target.
entries.reason: Every version bump must name its cause.

entries.base_behavior: SUPERSEDED, INVALIDATED and their reason codes exist but are undefined.
entries.amended_behavior: SUPERSEDED = a valid successor exists (newer version, or new box under the same thesis); INVALIDATED = basis lost with no valid successor. An invalid box with a concurrently derived replacement is SUPERSEDED. A valid successor satisfies its own BUILDING predicate. Both states are terminal. CONSUMED has no producer; EXPIRED stays reserved and unreachable.
entries.reason: Two terminal states need one rule that separates them.
